# DATA602_Final_Project
This is the Repo for the DATA602 Final Project

Project Name: Exploring Factors Linked to Heart Disease

Topic: This project examines how gender, existing health conditions, exercise habits, and other lifestyle factors are associated with heart disease.

1. Ramith Wijesinghe
2. Brian Liu
3. Zhuoxin Xia
